Cost Per Dose: 150eb (Premium)

A street-made alternative to multiple pharmaceuticals at once which boosts adrenaline and dopamine to absurd levels.

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 1 hour.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, users that were under the effect of a different drug, poison, or intoxicant prior to taking a dose of Superjet do not suffer the effects of those substances. Any newly-ingested substances, however, still apply their effects (if any) as normal.
  • For the duration of the primary effect, the user ignores any penalties from a lack of sleep, discomfort, stress, or similar.
  • For the duration of the primary effect, the user feels extremely amped up, confident, and ready to fight. They also cannot voluntarily fall asleep during this time, but can still be knocked Unconscious as normal.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV17) ⋘

  • The user takes 2 points of Humanity Loss.
  • If the user wasn’t addicted to Superjet before, they are now. While addicted, the user’s INT is permanently reduced by 2.

NOTE: This drug is based on what Mitch says you give to Saul during the Riders on the Storm side quest in Cyberpunk 2077.

Cost: 150eb (Premium) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "Superjet Addiction" effect.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
